beats.say: Bulls don't hate the color red. They can barely even see it.
The matador waves a red cape, the bull charges, so obviously the bull hates red. Except bulls can't really see red the way we do.
Cattle have two color vision, so to a bull, that bright red cape looks more like a dull, muddy brown.
What actually makes the bull charge is the movement. Wave a blue cape, a green cape, or your grandma's tablecloth, and you'll get the exact same result.
The red is for the crowd. It's not science. It's show business.
